description: Create or update elements. Re-using an id updates only the given fields. Arrows bind with from/to element ids.

backgroundColor.description: Fill colour: hex, palette name (light shade) or transparent.

endArrowhead.description: Same values as startArrowhead (default arrow for arrows, none for lines).

fontSize.description: Font size in px (default 20, arrow labels 16).

frame.description: Id of a frame to place this element in ("" to remove from its frame).

from.description: Arrow/line start: id of the element to connect from (edge point computed automatically).

groupIds.description: Group ids; elements sharing a group id move together.

id.description: Readable id (letters, digits, _ . : -). Reuse an existing id to update that element; omit to auto-generate.

label.description: Text centered inside a shape, on an arrow, or a frame name. "" removes it.

locked.description: Lock the element against editing in the canvas.

rounded.description: Rounded corners (default true for rectangles, diamonds, arrows, lines).

startArrowhead.description: arrow | bar | dot | circle | circle_outline | triangle | triangle_outline | diamond | diamond_outline |…

strokeColor.description: Outline/text colour: hex or palette name (black gray red pink grape violet indigo blue cyan teal green lime…

text.description: Content of a text element (use \n for new lines).

to.description: Arrow/line end: id of the element to connect to.

width.description: Width in px. Shapes auto-size to their label when omitted.

x.description: Left edge in canvas px (for arrow/line/freedraw: origin of points).

name: canvas_draw
